behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the window loads one byte at (rdi), selects a pointer by a zero test, and computes a length as 3*(byte^1)+14

branches.nonzero_path: byte != 0: pointer 0x21bfa3, length 3*(byte^1)+14; only byte 1 lands exactly on a name boundary ("invalid length", 14)
branches.spanning_note: for byte >= 2 the slice starts at 0x21bfa3 and runs past "invalid length" into the following concatenated name bytes (byte 2 -> "invalid lengthSystemTim", byte 3 -> "invalid lengthSystem", byte 4 -> "invalid lengthSystemTimeError")

behavior.formula: byte = *(rdi) as unsigned byte; pointer = 0x21bf92 if byte == 0 else 0x21bfa3; length = 3*(byte^1)+14; return (rax = pointer, rdx = length)
behavior.output_shape: two registers per path, then ret; rax is the pointer, rdx is the length

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend; the file stores 0 in the .data.rel.ro slot, applied only at load time
